Samuel Achterberg-Osei
Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer
[EMAIL] | [PHONE]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Cloud infrastructure engineer with 8+ years of IT experience across municipal IT, Azure infrastructure, systems administration and freelance Microsoft 365 security work. Hands-on experience designing and operating Azure environments, building Terraform infrastructure and Azure DevOps deployment pipelines, and operating AKS. Delivered a 60-server VMware-to-Azure migration without unplanned downtime and replaced manual deployments for 15 internal applications with automated pipelines.

CORE SKILLS
Cloud and infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, Azure IaaS, Azure landing zones, Azure Migrate, Azure VMs, App Service, AKS operations (upgrades, node pools, ingress), VMware, Proxmox
Infrastructure as code and automation: Terraform, Terraform modules, drift detection, PowerShell, Python (small scripts)
Networking: Hub-and-spoke networking, VNets, VNet peering, site-to-site VPN, Azure Firewall, private DNS, private endpoints
CI/CD and containers: Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, Docker, Helm, Terratest (Go)
Systems and security: Windows and Linux servers, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access, mailbox auditing, backups

EXPERIENCE
Cloud Engineer (Contract) | Havenstad Logistics | 2025–Present
- Design and maintain Azure landing-zone infrastructure using Terraform, including hub-and-spoke networking across three subscriptions.
- Implemented Azure Firewall, private DNS zones, private endpoints for storage and SQL, and VNet peering; added Terratest module tests and nightly drift detection.
- Replaced manual deployments for 15 internal .NET and Node applications with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines to App Service or AKS; deployment frequency increased from roughly monthly to several times per week for most apps.
- Operate AKS, including upgrades, node pools and ingress; application manifests are owned by developers.

Systems Administrator | Maasbrug Gemeente IT Services | 2014–2020
- Administered Windows and Linux servers and VMware infrastructure for municipal services, supporting approximately 250 servers.
- Planned and executed migration of 60 servers from VMware to Azure IaaS using Azure Migrate; completed cutovers over six weekends with no unplanned downtime.
- Automated repetitive administration with PowerShell.

Freelance IT Support | Freelance | 2022–2023
- Created repeatable PowerShell scripts and a checklist for small-business Microsoft 365 security baselines, covering MFA, Conditional Access, mailbox auditing and backups.

CAREER BREAKS
Mar 2020–Aug 2022 | Full-time caregiving for father; provided unpaid IT help for church and family and maintained Azure Administrator Associate knowledge.
Feb 2024–Feb 2025 | Completed a part-time, online, three-month English-language cloud bootcamp (Dec 2024); studied Terraform, passed Terraform Associate in 2025, and built a Proxmox homelab.

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAINING
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
Terraform Associate certification (2025)
English-language cloud bootcamp, part-time and online (completed December 2024)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity engagement. In my current contract as a Cloud Engineer at Havenstad Logistics, I design Azure landing-zone infrastructure with Terraform and build Azure DevOps pipelines, experience that aligns closely with Corvale’s need to take cloud infrastructure from design into production.

At Havenstad, I built a hub-and-spoke network across three subscriptions, including Azure Firewall, private DNS, private endpoints for storage and SQL, and VNet peering. I added Terratest module tests and nightly drift detection. I also replaced manual deployments for 15 .NET and Node applications with YAML pipelines targeting App Service and AKS; most applications moved from roughly monthly deployments to several times per week. I operate AKS upgrades, node pools and ingress, working alongside developers who own the application manifests.

My earlier systems administration work included Windows and Linux servers and a successful migration of 60 VMware servers to Azure IaaS, completed over six weekends without unplanned downtime. Together with my Microsoft 365 security-baseline work using PowerShell, this gives me a practical foundation in infrastructure operations, network design, automation and security. I would bring Azure-focused cloud engineering, Terraform and production delivery experience to Corvale’s train-to-cloud platform.

Corvale’s work to connect a new train fleet with backend services makes this engagement a strong match for my infrastructure background. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I could contribute to designing and operating a reliable, observable and secure platform.

Kind regards,
Samuel Achterberg-Osei
